procedure: Imported the original two-fabric Harbor OBJ as a garment at metre scale, 100%, Y up, with Trace 2D Patterns from UV Map enabled.

With both imported panels selected, opened File > Export > OBJ (Selected). Expanded the pattern list and unchecked the first of two rows. The two row values became 0 and 1 and Select All Patterns became unchecked.
Exported one thin, unwelded object at metre scale. Resolved the used material and independently integrated triangle areas and exterior edge lengths. Closed the unsaved scratch garment.
limits: The reference remeshed the imported garment. The return retained one diffuse fabric and its physical surface. It contained no OBJ group records.

The reference test changed the export-dialog pattern list after both imported patterns were selected. It does not establish the default list state for a single workspace selection, or draped, textured and animated selections.
